xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company had received Show Cause Notice on 10.02.2019 from Service Tax department regarding non payment of Service tax (Rs. 76.59 Lakh) on ocean Freight paid by foreign suppliers on the Company's imports under RCM. The Company has received summon from Directorate of Revenue Intelligence, Kolkata regarding evasion of custom duty paid through DEPB License and has confirmed the demand of Rs. 11.47 Lakhs for Custom Duty + Rs. 11.47 Lakhs for Penalty and Rs. 11.47 Lakhs for Interest .
